title: Python Functions and Errors in Depth

category.name: Python
category.description: Learn Python from your first line of code to data and automation.

short_description: Function arguments, scope, lambda, recursion, your own exceptions, the built-in functions and the statistics and cmath modules.
description: Functions are where Python programs get their shape. This course goes past def and return: every way to pass arguments, including *args and **kwargs, where a name lives (scope, global and nonlocal), small lambda functions and functions that build functions, recursion, raising and defining your own exceptions, a tour of the built-in functions worth knowing, and two handy maths modules, statistics and cmath. Take it after Python for Absolute Beginners or Python Essentials.
